answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, forfeited on duplicate submission. The ridge holds work receipts rather than names, so the saffron of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Reaching the haven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
